annotations.title: Turn view-only mode on or off

description: View-only mode for a hosted drop (Pro): blocks text selection, right-click, copy, save and print, blurs the page while the window is in the background, and tiles a watermark with the viewer's email (when the drop collects emails) or 'Confidential'. These deter casual copying; they can't stop a phone camera. on=false turns it off. Locked drops pick it up on the next republish with protect on.
name: set_view_only
title: Turn view-only mode on or off
